Jensen has returned, like Gandalf, to save NVIDIA from the hordes causing the stock to fall. With the support of the Federal Government, including President Trump and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Jensen Huang has been re-appointed to helm NVIDIA as CEO. This follows monstrous earnings from the past week and an 11-day saga of being removed as CEO, pending congressional investigations, SEC investigations into NVIDIA's accounting, and hearings with Jensen and NVIDIA alike. We're recapping the past week of Jensanity, plus an extended, unscripted, and heartfelt rant about some of the government's sudden interest in enforcing competition laws.
